title: Repair a durable job queue
goal: Repair the file-backed job queue across store.py, job_queue.py, and worker.py. Enqueueing an existing ID must preserve the original job. Claims must honor leases and reclaim an expired claim while counting attempts. Failed jobs may retry until max_attempts, then become terminal; completed jobs must never run again. Every state change must survive reopening the store. Preserve the public classes and methods used by the tests. Time is supplied as a number by the caller; do not read the real clock.
